title: Identity provider for the Access application is elicited (recommendedDefault null)
context: Cloudflare Access supports many identity providers (OTP, Google, GitHub, Okta, Entra ID, SAML, OIDC, mTLS); the choice is an enterprise-integration decision.
decision: Identity provider is elicited (elicited: true). No recommended default; the applied-sidecar records the operator's answer.
consequences: The elicitation forces an explicit operator answer at apply. Standards trace clause: generic enterprise practice.
